- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The MOSE project involves constructing mobile flood barriers to protect Venice from rising waters but has faced delays and cost overruns.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Other sustainable solutions include building structures on stilts, increasing green spaces, and implementing stricter building regulations.
